reviews.title: Overclock to 260hz. 400 nits brightness
reviews.comment:
Very nice. Windows says it's about 400 nits peak brightness even though it says 300 nits on the product page and it certainly looks bright enough.
You can also overclock it to 260hz.
Downside is it only comes with hdmi so you might need a separate displayport.
reviews.author: Kindle Customer
